capabilities: pair a vault with a paper.college account using a pairing code
sync glossary notes, paper notes, and the mindmap into the vault as Markdown and Canvas files
open paper PDFs in a temporary in-memory view that never writes files to the vault
overwrite only plugin-synced notes by marking them with a paper_sync frontmatter flag
disambiguation: Works only with the paper.college service; it does not manage local PDF libraries or other reference managers.
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly: true). The in-app Disconnect only clears the local token; revoking access requires the paper.college settings page, a known bug with a fix pending. Device tokens are stored in plain text in data.json and travel with vault copies.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull paper.college glossary and mindmap content into a vault or to read those papers without saving PDF files locally.
summary: Syncs glossary notes and a mindmap from paper.college into your vault as Markdown and Canvas files, and opens paper PDFs in a temporary in-memory view.
